name: cafera
description: CAFERA — Discover. Brew. Enjoy. A premium coffee discovery and recipe platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @cafera/shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -n shared,web -c gray,cyan "npm run dev -w @cafera/shared" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:server: concurrently -n shared,api -c gray,magenta "npm run dev -w @cafera/shared" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
